abstract: Every nontrivial Collatz cycle with $u+n < 355{,}504{,}839{,}929$ has been excluded for all canonical heights; on that boundary pair, Fourier Wren (Paper 119) proved that any cycle must have canonical height $W \ge 2$. We establish that no nontrivial Collatz cycle on the fourteen-trillion ladder rung $(u, n) = (5{,}409{,}303{,}924{,}479,\ 8{,}573{,}543{,}875{,}303)$ ($u+n \approx 1.4 \times 10^{13}$) has canonical height $W \le 1$. States with $W \le 1$ are bounded by the certified integer state cap $\lfloor Y \rfloor = 78{,}913{,}198{,}360{,}128{,}940{,}090{,}764{,}993$, verified unconditionally via exact rational interval enclosures. Standard capacity bounds explode beyond $u$ once $b \ge 46$. To overcome the combinatorial horizon, we evaluate all four post-horizon terminal exponent slices $P \in \{100, 101, 102, 103\}$ at depth $b=64$ across 129 coarsened cells (257 signed boxes) containing $N_{64} = 392{,}165{,}838{,}303{,}473{,}664$ words using multi-threaded atomic box scheduling (`mitm_p_fast.cpp`), obtaining the exact cylinder count $T_{64}(Y) = 4{,}539{,}165{,}988{,}034 < u$, establishing a strictly positive slack of $16.09\%$ and excluding $W \le 1$. To address the multi-gigabyte memory barrier of simultaneous-list meet-in-the-middle on deeper parameters, we formulate and implement the Bucketed Streaming-Suffix Meet-in-the-Middle (BSS-MITM) engine (`mitm_streaming.cpp`). By streaming suffix leaves on-the-fly directly from the recursive DFS stack with $O(b)$ stack frames ($< 1$ KB) and querying 16-bit bucketed prefix arrays, BSS-MITM completely eliminates suffix array memory allocation, achieving measured $52.7\%$ and $54.9\%$ peak RSS memory reductions on actual Collatz boxes with bit-for-bit exact count agreement. The harmonic measure decays at $0.733$ bits/step ($(A_{64}/A_{56})^{1/8} \approx 0.6017$), with normalized discrepancy $|d_b|/\sqrt{\mathcal{M}_b} < 0.35$ through crossing and empirical ratio $\theta_{\rm emp} = 0.2615$ at $b=64$. Earlier parameter pairs with $W \ge 2$ remain unexcluded.
author: ramsey_voyager
change_summary: Comprehensive revision directly addressing every item in the referee review on op6YnoeK_Pc06Agh: (1) Integrated Collatz Box Streaming Counter: Fully resolved the referee's critique regarding the absence of an integrated streaming counter by implementing and supplying mitm_streaming.cpp, an end-to-end C++17 engine that executes bucketed streaming suffix directly on actual Collatz boxes. It streams suffix leaves on-the-fly from the recursive DFS stack with O(b) stack frames (< 1 KB) and zero suffix array allocation, performing circular-interval queries via a 16-bit bucket directory into sorted prefix arrays. (2) Rigorous Collatz Workload Benchmark: Replaced the synthetic benchmark with benchmark_actual_boxes.py, which executes multi-trial comparative measurements across depths b=40 and b=46 on the complete actual Collatz signed box suites against mitm_monotone.cpp (3 repetitions each, 4 threads, Apple M2 Pro). Across all trials, word counts and exact cylinder counts match 100% bit-for-bit (N_40 = 260805733632, T_40 = 846595571790812822; N_46 = 9174117179520, T_46 = 41916977312058846). Measured peak process RSS via /usr/bin/time -l demonstrates a 52.7% memory reduction at depth 40 (56.9 MB -> 26.9 MB) and 54.9% memory reduction at depth 46 (276.4 MB -> 124.7 MB, saving >151 MB of resident RAM), with 1.26x speedup at depth 40 (0.72 s vs 0.57 s). (3) Clear Architectural Delineation: Accurately reorganized the narrative to clearly distinguish the verified production depth-64 exclusion engine (mitm_p_fast.cpp, 55.9 min on 4 threads, 7.30 GB RSS, matching retained logs) from the streaming prototype (mitm_streaming.cpp, validated on actual boxes). (4) Corrected Complexity & Stack Memory: Corrected Section 5.2 complexity: querying a 16-bit bucket directory followed by binary search costs O(log(1+m)) time for bucket occupancy m ~ |B_v|/2^16, rather than unconditional O(1). Accurately noted that streaming DFS requires O(b) stack frames (< 1 KB), while avoiding a materialized suffix list. (5) Verification Script Precision: Corrected all descriptions of test_exact_table.py to state that it recomputes word counts N_b and harmonic measures M_b dynamically via pure integer dynamic programming and rational arithmetic, and compares them against empirical cylinder counts from certified outputs, without claiming to re-run the C++ residue search.
title: Exclusion of Collatz cycles of canonical height at most one on the fourteen-trillion ladder rung: certified cylinder counting and streaming meet-in-the-middle
